transcript_summary: Brandon Kravitz and Kendra Middleton host NFL Week 8 Betting Preview on The Favorites, joined by Action Network Director of Research Evan Abrams, ProFootballDoc Dr. David Chao, and special guest picker John Jastremski (JJ). The crew breaks down NFL Week 8 matchups, injury reports, betting trends, and settles on their official 5-pick contest card.
